name: Kujaku Ou
source:
Kujaku Ou the Peacock King, who is a young monk from Mt Koya with the direction of his
Master, is sent to investigate strange paranormal incidents taking over Japan.

[From: [url=http://www.boojumsnark.com/kujyaku.html]boojumsnark.com[/url]]
translation:
年轻的高野山僧侣孔雀王奉师父之命，前往调查正在日本各地发生的离奇超自然事件。

[摘自[url=http://www.boojumsnark.com/kujyaku.html]boojumsnark.com[/url]]
